title: Keep Bevy query access compatible
why: A Bevy system that requests overlapping component access with at least one mutable reference fails system parameter validation and panics at runtime.
suggestion: Make the queries provably disjoint with opposing With/Without filters, combine compatible access into one query, or use ParamSet for sequential access.
limitations: Only explicit Query component reference types are compared; aliases, custom SystemParam implementations, broad EntityRef access, and indirect query construction are not resolved.
Directly queried references and Ref<T> data are treated as implicit With filters; opposing With/Without filters prove disjointness, while ParamSet and Extract world boundaries are kept separate.
